label: Support desk
tagline: See every ticket queue and its workload
opening: You've joined the support team at **<<biz>>**, where tickets arrive faster than anyone can count them. The team lead wants a program that shows every queue and how long it will take.
rule: The staffing rule: a queue of **<<level>> tickets or fewer** can be handled by one agent. A bigger queue needs an extra agent.
scene: A manager asks in chat: "How many tickets are waiting in <<n2>>?" Nobody should scroll the whole board. The system needs a quick lookup, and it must cope with queues that don't exist.

action.name: needs_extra_agent
action.doc: say whether one agent is not enough

glossary: One customer request, tracked from first message to resolution.
A waiting line of tickets of the same kind.
The minutes an agent spends on one ticket.
Total agent minutes a queue needs: tickets times handle time.
Service level agreement: the promised response or fix time.
Passing a hard ticket to a more senior team.
Tickets waiting that nobody has started yet.
py_uses: Auto-sort incoming tickets by topic and urgency
Alert the team before a ticket breaches its SLA
Turn thousands of chats into a weekly trends report
